summary: KE Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Hong Kong Exchange announcement of a routine employee equity award. On October 1, 2026, the company granted an aggregate 471,120 restricted share units, representing an equal number of Class A ordinary shares, to 15 employees under the 2020 Share Incentive Plan at nil purchase price. The Class A shares closed at HK$44.60 the prior business day. None of the grantees is a director, chief executive, or substantial shareholder. Vesting runs 24 to 48 months; no shareholder approval or special-situation mechanics apply.
